form.title: Contact form
form.lead: Write to us and we will reply within 24 hours.
form.name: Name
form.requiredNote: * Required fields. Phone number is optional.
form.consent: I agree to the use of the information provided to respond to my enquiry.
form.success: Your message has been accepted. We will reply within 24 hours.
form.error: We could not send your message. Your text is still in the form. Please try again later.
form.uncertain: We could not confirm submission. Your message may have been received; check the available contact channels before trying again.
form.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
form.validationError: Please check the form fields and try again.
form.unavailable: The form is not connected yet. Message submission is temporarily unavailable.

privacy.title: How data is used
privacy.text: Contact form data is used to respond to your enquiry. Seminar registration data is used to organise participation and send the joining link. Do not include confidential information in the forms. Before launch, the organiser must publish a full privacy notice identifying the data controller, retention periods and contact details for requests.
